attributes.board_name: Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology and Hearing Aid Dispensers Board (SLPAHADB)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Only from a Board-approved provider, an accredited institution of higher learning, or a provider approved by ASHA, AAA or the California Medical Association CME program. Self-study max 12 hours; indirect patient/client care (legal/ethical issues, record-keeping, office management, etc.) max 6 hours; teaching a qualifying course once per period; Board occupational analysis 2 hours. No credit for marketing/product-launch courses or personal finance/business courses.
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: 12 hours (max 6 self-study, max 3 indirect care); dual SLP + audiology licensees 8 hours per license.
rules.audit_note: Board may audit; keep records of completion at least 2 years beyond the renewal date (16 CCR §1399.160.12). No grace period: if CPD is not done, the license can be renewed as inactive.

topics.who: SLPs supervising SLP assistants or Required Professional Experience (RPE) temporary license holders: 6 hours before assuming supervision, then 3 hours every 4 years

rules.notes: Dual SLP + audiology licensees: 16 hours for each license (max 8 self-study, 4 indirect each). Audiologists may take no more than 50% hearing-aid-dispensing courses; dispensing audiologists' table line shows 12 hours with exactly 50% on hearing aid dispensing (SLP + dispensing audiologist: 16 and 8 hours). Self-study and indirect-care caps were raised by the regulation effective January 1, 2025.
rules.rule_quote: …Speech-Language Pathologist or Audiologist 24 hours 12 hours 6 hours…

rules.accepted_credit_types: State or regional conferences, workshops, formal in-service presentations, independent study programs on communication and related disorders; Board-approved providers optional; no limit on self-study. Supervisor helps select the courses.
rules.audit_note: The Board does not receive completion records from providers; keep your own records.
rules.notes: 12 hours of continuing professional development per renewal period.
rules.rule_quote: Speech-Language Pathology Assistant are required to complete twelve (12) hours of continuing professional development for each renewal period.
